annotations.title: Search new startup funding rounds (SEC Form D)

description: New private fundraises from SEC Form D filings: company, address, phone, industry, amount raised and offered, number of investors, securities, first sale date and the founders, executives and directors named in each filing. Filter by state, industry, amount and company age; pooled investment funds and amendments left out by default. Use for sales prospecting, investor research and deal flow. Runs the Apify Actor tacps126/startup-funding on your Apify account (about $0.005 per filing; spend per call is capped at $0.5).

extra_input.description: Advanced: extra Actor input fields, merged over the defaults.

max_items.description: Maximum results to return (default 50, max 1000). Cost scales with this.

min_amount_raised.description: Only raises that sold at least this many dollars.

posted_within_days.description: Filings in the last N days (about 300-500 per weekday).

query.description: Words in the filing, e.g. a company name.

name: search_startup_funding

count.description: Number of records the Actor returned.

items.description: The records. Long text fields are shortened to 600 characters.

shown.description: Number of records included in `items` (can be lower than count when the result is long).

tool.description: Name of the tool that produced the result.

truncated.description: True when records were left out to keep the result short; ask for fewer items.

title: Search new startup funding rounds (SEC Form D)
